_direction: Cold Chain — app-first grocery. Near-white surfaces, near-black type, one citrus signal colour reserved for state and intervention. Mono for prices, units and quantities. Sharp radii, dense grids, minimal chrome.

componentPatterns.nav: Sticky, white, 1px bottom border. Three-zone: wordmark left, a wide search field taking the centre (search is the primary grocery navigation, not an afterthought), delivery-slot chip + account + basket-count pill right. A secondary aisle bar sits beneath it on desktop — horizontal scrolling list of aisle names in nav-size uppercase-tracking type, no icons, active aisle marked by a 2px underline in primary.
componentPatterns.cards: Product card: white on a #F4F6F5 page band or white page, 1px #E3E7E5 border, radius-md, no shadow at rest and shadow-sm on hover. Icon/illustration block at top on a #F4F6F5 tile. Content padding 1rem. Order is eyebrow (aisle, mono uppercase, muted) → name (Space Grotesk 700, tight tracking, max 2 lines) → pack description (small, muted) → price row. Price row is baseline-aligned flex: price in mono 700 left with unit price in mono small muted beside it, badge right. Add-to-basket is a full-width button at the card foot that becomes a mono quantity stepper once the item is in the basket.

buttons.primary: Solid #0C0E0D, text #D9F154, radius-sm, 0.5625rem 1rem padding, IBM Plex Sans 600, no shadow. Hover lifts background to #1E221F. The citrus-on-black is the demo's signature — do not use it for ordinary links.
buttons.secondary: Transparent, 1.5px #D5DAD8 border, text #0C0E0D, same radius and padding. Hover darkens border to #0C0E0D.
buttons.text: No border or fill, text #1B6B47, IBM Plex Sans 500, underline on hover.

componentPatterns.grid: Product grid is the core layout. 2 columns at mobile, 3 at md, 4 at lg, 5 at xl within max-w-page. Gap 1rem — tight, so the grid reads as a dense catalogue rather than a spacious lookbook. Aisle pages put filters in a 240px left rail (sticky) against the grid, a 70/30-ish asymmetry, collapsing to a filter drawer below lg.
componentPatterns.hero: No giant marketing hero. The homepage opens with an asymmetric 65/35 band: left is a delivery-slot prompt with a live 'next slot' time in mono and a primary CTA; right is a compact reorder-favourites strip. Full-bleed promo imagery is avoided — the first product row must be visible above the fold on a laptop.
componentPatterns.footer: White, 1px top border, four link columns in small type with mono uppercase column headings, wordmark and delivery-area note on a final row. Restrained — no newsletter takeover.
componentPatterns.dataDisplay: All numerics use IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures: prices, unit prices, quantities, basket totals, delivery-threshold progress, slot times. This is the density signal that separates the design from a generic ecommerce template.
componentPatterns.intervention: Personalization interventions render as a single-line banner or an inline card slot using #D9F154 as the ground with #0C0E0D text — the only place the citrus appears as a large fill. Because the rest of the palette is monochrome, an intervention is unmistakable without being garish.
